Wildflowers

Words and music by Dolly Parton / arr. Andy Beck
Item: 00-PO-0008182
Voicing: SATB
Alfred Pop Choral
Available: SATB, SAB, 2-Part
Written by Dolly Parton for the Grammy-winning album Trio, this tender, front-porch folk ballad personifies a wildflower that refuses to be tamed by the garden she was planted in---creating a heartfelt metaphor about self-discovery and the freedom to find your own place. Andy's contemporary treatment reimagines the piece for the concert stage and elevates the song's warmth. A meaningful choice for graduation, spring programs, or any performance.

recentItems.title: Drawing the Circle Wider: Bringing Instrumentalists into Choir | Dr. Joshua Cheney, presenter
recentItems.description:
Some of our strongest choral recruits come from the band or orchestra room, but transitioning from an instrument to the voice can be a daunting shift for many students. This session offers a practical roadmap for successfully integrating instrumentalists into your choir. We will discuss effective recruitment strategies, how to bridge the gap between their instrumental technique and vocal production, and explore how to connect them with choral text. Join us to discover how to turn talented players into confident, engaged singers who elevate the leadership and skill level of your entire ensemble.

recentItems.title: Teaching Well, Living Well: Preventing Burnout | Dr.  Abigail van Klompenberg, presenter
recentItems.description:
Music educators face numerous responsibilities, making their role uniquely demanding. The intensity of these difficulties can leave individuals feeling overwhelmed and distressed. This session will explore issues related to stress and well-being, including eustress, burnout, compassion fatigue, and secondary traumatic stress. Participants will gain practical, real-world strategies to develop healthy, sustainable ways of being and prevent burnout.
